tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and chat background: pure white in light. Revised 2026-11-20.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: your own chat bubbles, search fields, the stage behind Billy. Revised 2026-11-20 from #f3e4d0.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, the composer and cards that sit inside a bubble (a Reminder row in Billy's reply), with a line border.

tokens.name: bubble-billy
tokens.usage: Billy's chat bubbles and suggestion cards: a barely-there fill on surface, no border.

tokens.name: bubble-you
tokens.usage: The person's own chat bubbles: a solid forest pill, the strongest fill in the chat.

tokens.name: on-bubble-you
tokens.usage: Text on bubble-you (7.9:1 light, 7.3:1 dark), the same as on-forest.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: The app-icon background plate (sampled from icon-background-light/dark.png). Use behind the icon foreground and on launch or splash screens.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Marketing site only: the sky behind Billy's pixel world (hills, water, sun, clouds from @repo/mascot world artwork) and the bands that continue it. Light is sampled from the landing mocks in the Billy chat canvas. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or forest-ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface (14:1+ light, 12:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps and taglines on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised, bubble-billy and plate (4.7:1+ light, 4.5:1+ dark). Light darkened from #6b6560 on 2026-11-21 so it passes on plate.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around bubbles, cards and menus. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline for dividers and chip outlines paired with a fill. Below 3:1, so not a control edge on its own.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders that must show where a control is: the composer, text fields, unselected chips (3.1:1+ on surfaces in both themes).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The primary action: one filled button per view, links and selected navigation. Light value is the preview's button; dark proposed. Text on it is on-forest.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest fill (7.9:1 light, 7.3:1 dark). Dark value is the preview's label shadow ink.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Calm green grounds: confirmation cards in chat (Reminder updated), success notices. Light value from the iOS chat mock.

tokens.name: forest-ink
tokens.usage: Text on forest-soft (10:1+ in both themes). Light value from the preview's home panel.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Brand accent taken from Billy's fur: radio and checkbox accent-color, small emphasis, inline icons on surface (6:1+ light, 5.2:1+ dark). Light value is the preview's accent-color; dark proposed.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Selected state fill for chips, segmented options and list rows.

tokens.name: honey-line
tokens.usage: Border of a selected chip on a honey fill.

tokens.name: on-honey
tokens.usage: Text on a honey fill (9.8:1 light, 8.1:1 dark). Light value from the preview's checked label.

tokens.name: avatar-ground
tokens.usage: The disc behind Billy's portrait next to his latest message.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word or icon too (6.1:1+ light, 5.4:1+ dark on surfaces). Proposed: the source has no status colors.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset (7:1+ on every surface). Proposed.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Launch and welcome headlines only. From the preview's launch card.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Marketing site only: the one hero headline of a page on wide screens. Below 720px wide the site falls back to display-section. From the landing mocks in the Billy chat canvas (clamp up to 112px there).

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Marketing site only: section headlines, and the hero headline on narrow screens.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. From the preview's panel headings (18px, -0.03em).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Notes, reminders, and follow-ups in one chat.
styles.usage: Marketing site only: the paragraph under a hero or section headline. From the landing mocks in the Billy chat canvas.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Billy files the Note and brings it back when it matters.
styles.usage: Marketing site only: running text and card copy. body stays the chat size.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Chat messages and running text. Proposed.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Notes, reminders, and follow-ups in one chat.
styles.usage: Taglines and short emphasised lines. From the preview's launch tagline.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Marketing site only: button and navigation labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form legends, chip and button labels. From the preview's controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under thumbnails and icons. From the preview.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Marketing site only: commands in the self-host section.

spacing.note: Proposed 4px scale. The preview's own gaps (5, 10, 14, 18, 22px) round to these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; avatar to message text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a card; form row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding on launch and empty states.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large separation above a hero or empty-state mascot.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing site: gap between a section headline block and its content; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Marketing site: vertical padding of a page section on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: Corners where two bubbles of one sender's group meet, on the sender's side, as in Messenger. From the iOS chat mock.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, form controls. From the preview.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner panels such as the mascot stage. From the preview.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and top-level panels. The preview's --radius.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: Rounding for app-icon previews in mockups only; ship icon sources square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chat message lines and pills. From the preview.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Billy's circular portrait (mascot--portrait).

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: Under the large app icon on launch screens. From the preview.

tokens.name: shadow-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Under a small app icon on a green ground. From the preview.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Thumbnails and small floating tiles. From the preview.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: Under the floating composer above the chat. From the iOS chat mock.

meta.note: This file is the single source of the design tokens. Edit it here, run pnpm --filter @repo/tokens build, and sync the Billy design system from it.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of every touch target (design direction, principle 3).

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing site: height of the large hero and closing call-to-action buttons.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Billy's portrait beside his latest message: the portrait crop from the design system at the size of the iOS chat mock, which is also the touch target.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Marketing site: the widest the content column grows. Full-bleed scenery ignores it.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Marketing site: the longest line of running text (lede and body) for comfortable reading.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Press feedback and small state changes such as a chip toggle (100–200ms in the animate-expo skill). Proposed.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: A bubble or card entering the chat; UI motion stays under 300ms. Proposed.

tokens.name: duration-greet
tokens.usage: Billy's greeting (mascot--greet). From packages/mascot/web.css.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Strong ease-out for anything entering, exiting or giving feedback, and the default. Never ease-in on UI. From the animate-expo skill.

tokens.name: easing-move
tokens.usage: Ease-in-out for an element moving or morphing while it stays on screen. From the animate-expo skill.

tokens.name: easing-greet
tokens.usage: Billy's greeting moves in whole frames, like the pixel art. From packages/mascot/web.css.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Marketing site: hero bubbles and scrolled-in panels arriving. Explanatory motion may be longer than UI motion (emil-design-eng).

tokens.name: duration-theme
tokens.usage: Marketing site: the day and night circular reveal from the sun or moon, so the brightness change is eased, not a jump (apple-design).

tokens.name: duration-twinkle
tokens.usage: Marketing site: one twinkle of a night star or sparkle.

tokens.name: duration-bob
tokens.usage: Marketing site: one gentle float of a cloud or chat tile. Kept well away from the 5s loop that apple-design warns about.

tokens.name: duration-flow
tokens.usage: Marketing site: the water strip flowing one tile sideways.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: Marketing site: a large cloud crossing the sky. Smaller, farther clouds take longer (a multiple of this).

tokens.name: easing-drift
tokens.usage: Linear, for constant motion only: drifting clouds and flowing water.

tokens.name: easing-float
tokens.usage: Sine-like ease-in-out for things floating in place: clouds, tiles, the sun.

tokens.name: easing-drawer
tokens.usage: Sheets and drawers sliding in from an edge: the iOS drawer curve (emil-design-eng).

contrast.note: Every pair is checked in every theme by the package tests. A pair that is not listed is not approved for text or controls.
